items.period: Shang period (script style identified as Shang oracle; exact specimen convention unspecified)
items.caption: A modern vector redraw classified as Shang oracle script; the cited source image reference is Academia Sinica record 43.E628.
items.alt: An oracle-script form of 大, drawn as a front-facing human figure.
items.selection_reason: Earliest script category in this small set and supports discussing human-figure analyses; Commons records a specific Sinica source-image reference. The actual pixels still require visual review.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public-domain dedication stated on Wikimedia Commons file page.

items.period: Western Zhou (Commons category identification; no particular inscription date established)
items.caption: A modern vector redraw categorized as Western Zhou bronze script; it can illustrate a later labeled form, not a dated artifact specimen.
items.alt: A Western Zhou bronze-script style form of 大, shown as a clean digital line drawing.
items.selection_reason: Potentially useful bridge between the oracle-script candidate and seal script, but Commons search result supplied less specific provenance than the oracle file page.
items.rights: CC0 / public domain according to Wikimedia Commons search result.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; the source page does not assign an artifact date
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of the form identified as Shuowen seal script, for comparison with the earlier script-style candidate.
items.alt: The character 大 represented in a clean small-seal-script digital drawing.
items.selection_reason: Shows a later conventionalized form and lets users compare broad form continuity; do not describe as an ancient artifact photograph.
items.rights: Public-domain release; CC0 structured-data designation appears on Wikimedia Commons page.

limitations.text: These are modern SVG redrawings based on cited or listed character-form resources, not photographs of ancient oracle bones, bronzes, or seal artifacts. The visual agent should verify rendered pixels and shape fit before final selection.

The bronze candidate’s exact source specimen and its date were not established from the inspected search result; treat ‘Western Zhou’ as the Commons style/category label rather than a verified date for a specific artifact.
